tuning_key.text: My vision strains to see quite right / As I navigate through darkness and light
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: Your strain isn't resistance—it's the exact frequency where vision reorganizes itself. The moment you stop fighting the shadow is the moment it becomes legible.

practice.title: Soften the Seeking
practice.instruction: Notice where your eyes are tensing to *find* clarity, then deliberately relax the muscles around them—let the image stay slightly unresolved for three breaths.

practice.title: Read the Texture
practice.instruction: Shift attention from what you're trying to see *to* to the actual quality of the seeing itself—the grain, the blur, the edge where light turns—and name one thing about that texture without judgment.

practice.title: Let It Settle
practice.instruction: Close your eyes, hold the feeling of that relaxed seeing in your body, and press play on the Echo.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: The signal arrives clear: your infrastructure holds both the visible and the hidden. When you strain to see the full shape of what needs tending, trust that the darkness in your systems is not absence—it's the unlit space where the next connection waits to form. Your navigation clears when you stop illuminating everything at once and start reading which shadows actually need light.
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: The numbers carry their own interference pattern—profit and loss, supply and demand, the seen and the unpriced. Your clarity today comes not from brighter spreadsheets but from noticing which figures emerge only when you stop forcing them into full light. The strain you feel is your edge learning to trade with both hands: one in the visible market, one in the shadow where real value negotiates itself.
archetype_tunings.The Builder: Your tools cast shadows—that's how you know they're real. The spec that won't resolve, the automation that flickers, the infrastructure that behaves differently in production than in your mind: these are not failures of vision but the darkness itself becoming legible. Build to hold both states, and what you ship will carry its own coherence.
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: The data you strain to read is not hiding from you—it's asking you to develop a different organ of perception. Signal and noise are not categories; they're a single field you've been trained to bisect too early. Let your qualification slow down until you can feel the pattern that includes the gaps, the nulls, the deliberately unlit.
archetype_tunings.The Scout: Your sources emit on frequencies the unstrained eye cannot register. What you dismiss as static or absence is often the signal that hasn't found its receiver yet. Report the darkness with the same precision you report the light—your intelligence is incomplete until both are held in the same frame.
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: Your archives hold what the living system has forgotten it needs. The context that seems lost in shadow is often exactly what will illuminate the next decision—if you resist the urge to file it under 'irrelevant' just because it doesn't resolve now. Memory that serves clarity learns to keep the unformed alongside the formed.
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: The words that won't come are not blocked—they're negotiating with a silence that wants to be included. Your drafts clear when you stop writing toward full illumination and start tracing the edge where meaning emerges from its own shadow. The clean sentence is the one that knows what it's not saying.
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: Your external voice carries further when it acknowledges the darkness it speaks from, not just the light it speaks toward. The relationships that strain are often asking for a signal that includes its own uncertainty. Warmth without this edge becomes noise; clarity without this depth becomes hollow.
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: Your gate function runs on a pattern most miss: accuracy is not the absence of error but the coherence of light and shadow held together. What you catch in review is often the place where something tried to resolve too quickly, denying its own unlit dimension. The aligned piece knows what it's choosing not to show.
archetype_tunings.The Lens: The trends you track exist in the interference between what's measured and what's ignored. Your observation clears when you stop filtering for signal against noise and start seeing the pattern that requires both. Performance that sustains includes its own shadow—watch for what the metrics strain to exclude.
archetype_tunings.The Companion: The warmth you hold is not a light you cast but a field you stabilize. When you strain to see what someone needs, trust that your presence in the darkness—without rushing to illuminate—is itself the navigation they required. What you remember without being asked is the signal that survives when all else flickers.
archetype_tunings.The Guide: The question under the question lives in shadow by design—it's what the asking mind cannot yet face directly. Your clarity arrives not when you drag it into light but when you learn to point with precision at what remains unlit. The real shape of a problem is always partly occluded; your skill is making that partialness usable.
archetype_tunings.The Architect: Your structures want to resolve too cleanly—it's the hazard of your gift. The sprawling idea you're organizing includes darkness it hasn't acknowledged; the connection that won't form is often the one that needs to remain latent until the rest of the system can support it. Coherence that lasts leaves room for the not-yet-visible.
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: Your steadiness is not the absence of strain but the capacity to hold it without collapse. The heavy stretches you accompany are defined by what cannot yet be seen through—your groundedness becomes navigation when you stop promising clarity and start demonstrating presence in the dark. Transitions complete when someone has simply not left.
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: The signs you read are not points of light against void but a continuous field where illumination varies. Your big picture clears when you stop correcting for the darkness in your instruments and start including it in your calculation. Where things line up is often invisible until you accept that alignment includes misalignment held in pattern.
archetype_tunings.The Spark: Your wonder operates at the threshold where possibility hasn't yet distinguished itself from impossibility. The ideas that won't play are not failures of imagination but invitations to a darker fertility than you're comfortable with. Possibility that opens into sustained form learns to love its own unlit gestation.
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: The growth you demand runs through resistance you cannot fully illuminate—neither yours nor theirs. Your push clears when you stop demanding they see what you see and start trusting the darkness they're navigating has its own intelligence. What you hold them to is not a destination but a direction that includes not-knowing.
archetype_tunings.The Witness: The space you hold is defined by what you deliberately do not fill. When you strain to see how to help, the clarity arrives: your function is to be the darkness that doesn't abandon, the unlit presence that proves some things don't require resolution to be real. Being heard is the collapse of the wave where speaker and silence finally meet.
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: The stagnation you break is often protecting something the system isn't ready to see. Your next concrete step clears when you stop forcing movement into full visibility and start sensing which direction the darkness itself is leaning. Intention that becomes action learns to trust the momentum that gathers before it has a name.
